El Mercado de Origen no es el Vendedor d: El Mercado de Origen is not the Seller of products purchased through the Marketplace. The Seller identified for each Product is the party that enters into the purchase and sale contract with the Customer. Purchase contracts for Products offered by Sellers are formed between the Seller and the Customer subject to product availability. Sellers must confirm acceptance of an order within a maximum of 72 (seventy-two) hours after receiving it. If a Seller does not accept the order within that period, the purchase contract between the Customer and Seller will be automatically terminated and amounts paid by the Customer will be refunded.

El Mercado de Origen does not take part in the delivery process.
Es responsabilidad del Cliente confirmar: The Customer is responsible for confirming receipt of the Products and that they conform to the order. Products will be presumed received 21 (twenty-one) days after the respective dispatch date. This provision does not limit or affect consumer rights provided by law.
En caso de que los pedidos no lleguen al: If an order does not reach the Customer, arrives damaged, or does not match the information provided by the Seller at the time of purchase, the Customer may submit a claim directly to the relevant Seller. El Mercado de Origen will only assist as an intermediary with non-conformity issues for up to 45 (forty-five) days after the purchase. After that period, the matter must be handled directly between the Customer and Seller. Products purchased through the Marketplace cannot be returned to El Mercado de Origen or exchanged by El Mercado de Origen for other products. Returns are the Customer’s responsibility and must be arranged directly with the relevant Seller. Return conditions should be consulted on the respective Seller’s page at www.elmercadodeorigen.com. Disputes must be resolved directly between the Customer and the Seller.
En virtud de la legislación vigente, el: Under applicable law, the Customer has 14 (fourteen) days from receipt of the ordered Product(s) in which to withdraw from the contract with the Seller. Returning the Products is the Customer’s responsibility and must be arranged directly with the Seller; El Mercado de Origen does not take part in the return process. The Customer bears the cost of returning the goods unless the Seller expressly agrees to bear that cost. If the Seller does not offer to collect the goods, the Customer must return the Products to the Seller within 14 (fourteen) days after communicating the decision to withdraw. El Mercado de Origen will refund the amount paid for returned Products within a maximum of 14 (fourteen) calendar days from the date on which the Seller confirms receipt and conformity of the returned order, or the Customer provides El Mercado de Origen and/or the Seller with evidence that the goods have been returned.

Las cookies son un conjunto de datos que: Cookies are small data files that a server places in a user’s browser. They can be used to collect standard internet log information and information about how visitors interact with a website. Cookies are commonly used to remember information between visits, help websites operate efficiently, support personalisation and provide analytics about website use.
¿Qué tipos de cookies existen?: What types of cookies are there?
Las cookies utilizadas en nuestro sitio: Cookies used on this website may include session and third-party cookies. They can store or access information such as language, browser type and other general preferences, and can be used to analyse activity in order to improve and personalise services.
Las cookies, en función de su permanenci: According to how long they remain active, cookies may be session cookies, which expire when the browser is closed, or persistent cookies, which expire when their purpose has been fulfilled, on a set date, or when they are manually deleted.
Se usa para distinguir usuarios y sesion: Used to distinguish users and sessions.
Se usa para determinar nuevas sesiones o: Used to determine new sessions or visits
Al finalizar la sesión: At the end of the session

Este tipo de Cookie recuerda sus prefere: Performance cookies can remember preferences for features used on a service so that they do not need to be configured on every visit. Examples can include audio or video settings, compatible streaming settings, and items saved in an e-commerce shopping cart.
Estas cookies son utilizadas para averig: These cookies may be used to determine the country from which a service is requested, helping tailor content to a general location.
Las cookies de registro se generan una v: Login cookies may be created after a user registers or signs in and can be used to recognise the user within services for purposes such as:
Mantener al usuario identificado de form: Keeping the user signed in so that returning to the service does not always require a new login. If the user signs out, the relevant cookie may be removed and a new login will be required on the next visit.
Comprobar si el usuario está autorizado: Checking whether a user is authorised to access certain services, for example to take part in a competition.
Adicionalmente, algunos servicios pueden: Some services may also connect with social networks such as Facebook or Twitter. If a user signs in using social-network credentials, the relevant social network may store a persistent cookie to remember identity until it expires. The user can manage or revoke this access through the settings of the relevant social network.
Cada vez que un usuario visita un servic: When a user visits a service, a third-party analytics provider may generate an analytics cookie on the user’s device. This can be used on later visits to recognise a browser or device anonymously. The main purposes include:
Permitir la identificación anónima de lo: Allowing anonymous recognition of browsers and devices rather than individuals, so that approximate visitor numbers and trends over time can be measured.
Identificar de forma anónima los conteni: Identifying the most visited content anonymously and determining whether a browser appears to be a new or returning visitor.
